title: Answer
description:
The covenant belongs with the replanting of the two houses and with a city that stays. The letter quotes the inner writing, the knowing, and the not-remembering. It does not unhook them from that people.

The fault is in those who said they would do it and broke it. Words kept on a doorpost are not the same act as God writing them himself, which had been promised and not yet done.

The knowing is a betrothal and a teaching by God, not one man informing another. Not remembering is for his own sake. New means he announced the replacement of what they broke.
